svg.title: Kirov No. 247, the Soviet 6MX (1_Kirow_247_Z.jpg)
svg.desc: The Wempe model’s dial printing (marine-chronometer-source/wempe/js/dial.js face(1, ‘kirov’), its glyphs traced by dialtrace.py) as vectors, written by marine-chronometer-source/chronometer-working-model/tools/dialsvg.py: generated, don’t edit. mm, 1:1 (Ø 103.55), 12 at the top, the centre arbor at 0, 0. The printing after a photograph by Johannes Altmeppen (References/wempe/photos), traced: the photograph itself is not in this file.
